A growth loop is a repeatable cycle where an input produces an output that becomes a new input, compounding over time rather than resetting with every campaign.

The best growth loops are boring and durable: a referral loop where existing users bring new users, or a content loop where user-generated content drives organic search traffic, which brings in more users who generate more content.
